payload.text: A PUSH IS DONE when CI is GREEN on the pushed sha, or RED with exactly the baseline failures named (hv, 2026-09-22). BACK IN FORCE: Actions ran devbin's 0.1.9 push and its tag on 2026-10-07. Both read RED with exactly 0180's two Ubuntu arms, 0155's lint-worker arm and 0158's gate_exec arm, so that push is done under this rule, and those two are the baseline for the next push until 0180 lands.
